integration_decision.name: END_TO_END_POST_ORPHAN_RECOVERY_MUST_EXERCISE_RUN_ONCE_APPEND_PATH
integration_decision.finding: Prior parent append_observations(rowB) then run_once(network=False,external_jsonl=()) proves storage append/read separately but not that run_once itself can append after orphan cleanup. Exact runner.py collects external_jsonl via JsonlFlowAdapter and passes collected observations to append_observations before load_observations. Exact providers.py JsonlFlowAdapter parses FlowObservation.from_dict JSONL. This permits a stronger same-entrypoint post-orphan integration oracle without network or production edits.
integration_decision.no_network_test_contract: Isolate tmp_path, fixed T=1700000000000. Use existing positive-ACK child lock acquisition, controlled os._exit(17), bounded join, orphan existence and pre-cleanup TimeoutError; remove only test-owned orphan after confirmed child death. Write one separate input.jsonl containing canonical PIT-visible rowB.to_dict() (BTC ETF farside_etf net_flow_usd, effective=T-2000, available=observed=T-1000, source_record_id=rowB). Call runner.run_once(network=False,external_jsonl=(input_path,),local_dir=tmp_path,as_of_ms=T). Assert appended_observations==1, archive_records_loaded==1, scoring_records_loaded==1, source_errors==[], local collection_attempt OK/count1; load_observations(archive) exactly rowB, returned and persisted anata_latest.json scoring source_evidence effective.source_record_id=rowB; no leftover lock. Repeat identical run_once with same fixture; assert appended_observations==0, archive/scoring still 1/1, no duplicate rowB, same persisted identity, no lock. Bound waits; preserve fail-closed before cleanup; do not use sleep as causal oracle. Keep positive-ACK overlapping-writer, same-clock rollback and scoring/context role-identity contracts independent.
